failure_definition: Graft infection requiring explant and reconstruction
causal_mechanism: Bacterial colonization on the graft surface
current_device_behavior: The vascular graft is made of ePTFE, which is a non-biodegradable material that does not inherently prevent bacterial colonization.
failure_point: The external surface of the ePTFE luminal layer of the vascular graft
blocking_constraint: The need for a biocompatible, non-toxic, and non-immunogenic material that can be used as a biodegradable polymer layer, which limits the obvious solution of simply applying a broad-spectrum antimicrobial agent to the graft surface
